comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body:
321 base vert, 452 base horizontal when made with teak. So that's 439 vert and 542 horizontal on a corvette body (inately fast)... yeah, that's not going to be fast at all.

96 crew, emergency accelleration and wind resistant mast, more base armor than a vaisseau. It's going to accellerate quick, good top end speed and have enough crew to do something about it once it catches you.

This boys and girls is a pirate ship, and it looks pretty solid.

You can reach max V/H sails (90/90) when putting 5 sails and Antifoul-
ing Paint. So if you expect 1 or 2 times failure, Floatsam Search will
be best, 10/10 sails and 2 turnspeed. High Lookout's 20/20 sails are
a bit excessive, and the others have unnecessary or even harmful stats.
